news_items.headline: Analog Devices stock hits all-time high at $408.75
news_items.summary: ADI shares reached an all-time high of $408.75 amid continued semiconductor sector strength and bullish sentiment ahead of the May 20 earnings release.

news_items.headline: Analog Devices (ADI) Is Up 5.6% After Analyst Upgrades Ahead Of Earnings
news_items.summary: ADI rallied 5.6% following analyst upgrades pointing to stronger EPS and revenue ahead of the upcoming Q2 2026 earnings release.

news_items.headline: Citi places ADI on 30-day positive catalyst watch list citing AI/data center demand
news_items.summary: Citi reiterated Buy with $400 price target, expecting April and July quarter results to exceed estimates due to higher analog chip pricing and sustained AI/data center demand.

news_items.headline: ADI rising AI and data center revenue share reframes earnings power story
news_items.summary: AI and data center exposure now accounts for roughly one-fifth of ADI revenue, becoming central to the business mix and supporting expectations of continued growth.

news_items.headline: ADI CEO Vincent Roche sells $3.98M in stock
news_items.summary: CEO Vincent Roche reported sale of approximately $3.98 million in ADI stock. Insider sales near all-time highs may signal limited near-term upside in management's view.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Multiple analyst upgrades over the past week ahead of May 20 earnings; Citi reiterated Buy with $400 PT on AI/data center catalyst watch. Consensus: 29 Buy / 6 Hold / 0 Sell across 32 analysts.

earnings_context.notes: Q2 2026 earnings release on May 20, 2026 is the near-term catalyst. Street expects ~55.68% YoY EPS growth driven by AI/data center revenue ramp and higher analog chip pricing. S&P upgraded issuer credit to A from A- on April 17, 2026 (stable outlook).
